newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein weak in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein weak in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were weaker in late trading on Monday on the back of sustained demand and declines in Malaysia, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,410-1,415 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, down from 1,415 rupiah at the opening.

"Buying interest was just so-so today, with players staying cautious ahead of the May 29 general election," one trader said. "As has been the trend, players are buying just enough in a bid to keep stock levels low."
The traders said rioting in the South Kalimantan city of Banjarmasin last Friday had no direct impact on the market.
The death toll from a fire and riot in the city was reported to have risen to 142, but Jakarta was relatively calm mid-way through the cooling off period before balloting on Thursday.
The traders said the market was cool to the Banjarmasin incident because of its distance from capital Jakarta.

They said they expected market activity to return to normal after the election. "The market should become normal in the first week of June," one trader said. "But the outlook on prices is still bearish and we could see a further weakening."
